title: Fundamental Limits of Perfect Concept Erasure

bias_targets.methodology: Erasing gender information from GloVe embeddings and evaluating the privacy-utility tradeoff by measuring the Mean Squared Error (MSE) in predicting the original representations from the erased representations.

Erasing religion information from GPT-4 text embeddings of online comments in the Jigsaw dataset, and evaluating the fairness-utility tradeoff in a downstream toxicity classification task using generalized demographic parity across religious groups (Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim, and others).
